''See also: [[Mad King Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[The Mad King]], formerly known as the hero [[Daruman]], is a powerful and notorious figure characterized by his intense hatred for the [[Abidan]]. Once an [[Executor]] recruited to assist the [[Abidan]], his will was eventually corrupted by [[Oth’kimeth]], leading the [[Court]] to bestow upon him his current title. He is a conqueror and imperialist driven by a desire for glory and the pursuit of legendary deeds. He possesses a reputation for being generous toward his own people while remaining exceptionally cruel and ruthless to others. In combat, The Mad King{{!}}the Mad King is a formidable adversary who wields a black The Scythe{{!}}Scythe and a bone [[sword]] that carries the sorrow of many worlds. He has demonstrated the ability to strike at the foundations of heaven, even slicing an [[Iteration]] in half. His presence is so significant that it can warp Fate{{!}}fate and hide him from Way{{!}}the Way. Despite his immense power, his physical state has suffered; he possesses scarred [[madra channels]] and a weakened lifeline. He has endured many deaths, though he has the ability to revive himself, even as repeated [[destruction]] threatens to make his existence increasingly unstable. He maintains a citadel at the [[fortress]]-world of [[Tal’gullour]], where he resides with his people and prepares for war against the [[Abidan]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[The Mad King]] is a [[Vroshir]] who wears armor carved from the physical manifestation of a Class One Fiends{{!}}Class One Fiend. He manifests into reality holding a black scythe and has been described as an intruder in bone armor.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A commander who leads with his word, The Mad King{{!}}the Mad King seeks to strike blows that will topple the pillars of Heaven. His arrival signifies that something has gone terribly wrong, and he intends to ride to war once more.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|He can cast [[Makiel]] through space and has exploited openings to release waves of chaotic, many-colored fire. Additionally, he is capable of creating deadly weapons and utilizes a savage [[technique]] to defend himself during combat.}}
